review.brief: Review the tier-2 diff for gateway-history-graph-labels-tooltips (commits 8ee99ce wave-1, plus the wave-2 test commit) against: (1) design.md D1-D5 - tooltip AND label both sourced from EffectiveDate formatted MM-DD, with CapturedAt eliminated as a date source (D1; a surviving CapturedAt date path is a BLOCKER, it re-introduces the exact 1-day bug MAG-6 fixes); per-bar Label + adaptive orientation (D2); LabelVertical computed once in the handler, chart-level, never per-bar and never in the template (D3); SVG <text> + transform=rotate(-90 ...) with NO client-side charting library added (D4, gateway AGENTS.md RD8); Label pre-formatted in the handler, template logic-free - no time.Format, no days comparison, no rotation math in .templ (D5). (2) Module boundary: all edits inside internal/gateway/; no internal/telemetry/db (telemetrydb) import; gateway owns no business data. (3) ai/htmx-conventions.md + ai/htmx-go-integration.md compliance for the Templ markup; NO HTML comments in .templ (they ship to the browser). (4) Codegen guard: *_templ.go regenerated from .templ, and static/app.css regenerated and committed in this change (gateway AGENTS.md CI guard). Confirm the committed app.css actually contains any newly used classes. (5) Spec coverage: every scenario in specs/gateway/spec.md has a real test that ASSERTS the behaviour. (6) ANTI-GAMING - highest priority this round: two pre-existing tooltip tests (TestBuildOdometerChart_TooltipContainsDateAndKeywords, TestBuildBatteryChart_TooltipContainsDateLevelAndRange) were REPAIRED by the wave-2 worker because the contract deliberately changed. Verify they were strengthened, not weakened: every non-date assertion must survive, the date assertion must still assert a specific expected string, and a negative assertion proving CapturedAt is not the source should be present. Any dropped or loosened assertion is a blocker finding. Note task 5.3 (human visual check of the presets via make dev) is deliberately BLOCKED pending the user - do not treat it as an incomplete-work finding, and do not approve it yourself. Escalate on doubt: return changes-requested rather than approving anything you are not sure about.

findings.note: internal/gateway/static/input.css only @source's ../templates/**/*.templ, but Tailwind v4's automatic content detection also scans the whole project tree (respecting .gitignore) for candidate utility strings. openspec/changes/gateway-history-graph-labels-tooltips/progress.json task 3.3's own notes field literally contains the substrings "fill-base-content" (bare, no /60) and "text-[7px]/[8px]", so a from-scratch `make css` run today emits two extra unused classes (`.fill-base-content` merged into the /60 rule, and a `.text-\[7px\]\/\[8px\]{font-size:7px;line-height:8px}` rule) that are not in the committed internal/gateway/static/app.css and are not referenced by any markup. This is pre-existing Tailwind v4 CLI behavior (not something either wave worker did) and does not affect this change's correctness: the committed app.css already contains every class the new markup actually uses (fill-base-content/60, text-[7px], text-[8px], fill-primary, fill-secondary), verified by grep. Re-ran make css locally to confirm, then reverted the local diff with `git checkout -- internal/gateway/static/app.css` so no state was left dirty. Flagging only so the leader is aware the CI guard `make css && git diff --exit-code internal/gateway/static/app.css` is order-sensitive to progress.json prose and could someday false-positive; not a reason to request changes on this review.
Re-checked, still open, unrelated to this round's fix: unchanged by commit 61f5d43 (which does not touch static/input.css or progress.json's task-3.3 notes). Still informational only, not a blocker.

Grid/bar centre offset (leader's item 2): a bar is drawn at x=i, width=0.8, so its visual centre is i+0.4 in the SVG's N-unit-wide user space; its sibling grid cell (column i of an N-column `repeat(N, minmax(0,1fr))` track) is centred at i+0.5 of that same N-unit width. That is a 0.1-unit offset out of a 1-unit column, i.e. bars sit fractionally left of their label at every width. At the widest gap (N=6, ~16.7% column width) this is ~1.7% of a bar-slot width; at N=30 it is ~0.33% of total chart width — visually negligible in both cases, and both cells scale together so the offset does not grow or drift at different widths. Not a code defect (the grid IS driving both), and the label CENTER text-align already absorbs sub-pixel misalignment for a 2-4 char label like "08-07". Recommend no code change; flagging so the leader/user can eyeball it on the pending visual re-check (task 5.3) and decide if it is worth a follow-up (e.g. shifting bar x to i+0.1, width 0.8 unchanged, to center bars at i+0.5) — not a blocker for this round.

decisions.decision: Accepted reviewer finding R1-1 as informational; not fixing it in this change.
decisions.why: Tailwind v4 auto content-detection scans the repo tree, so prose in progress.json containing class-like substrings can emit two unused classes on a from-scratch make css. Pre-existing tooling behaviour, unrelated to this change's markup, and the committed app.css already carries every class the new markup uses. Fixing it means narrowing the Tailwind source globs - a separate concern.

decisions.decision: REVISE design D4 (D4-R1): per-bar date labels move out of the SVG into a sibling HTML grid row; vertical orientation becomes a CSS class instead of an SVG rotate transform.
decisions.why: Task 5.3's visual check found the labels render as an illegible smear. Root cause: the chart uses preserveAspectRatio="none" with viewBox 0 0 <numBars> 120 in a w-full h-28 box, so at 14 days x scales ~57x and y ~0.93x (ratio ~61:1). Rects are unaffected; text glyphs are stretched flat. rotate(-90) is applied pre-stretch so vertical text becomes horizontal streaks. No font size can fix a scale-factor defect. User chose the HTML grid row over a second label-only SVG.

decisions.decision: Accepted reviewer finding R2-1 as informational; not changing bar x-positions in this change.
decisions.why: Bars draw at x=i width=0.8 (centre i+0.4) while grid cells centre at i+0.5, a <=1.7% bar-slot offset. Correcting it means nudging every bar's x, a visual change beyond the label scope the user approved. Surfaced to the user for the 5.3 visual re-check instead - their call, one-line fix if they want it.
